newsitem.title: USA: Americas investor opposes Advanced merger.
newsitem.headline: Americas investor opposes Advanced merger.

text.p: A private investor in Americas Growth Fund Inc said Monday he is opposed to the merger agreement with Advanced Electronic Support Products Inc, citing alleged excessive payments to Americas' chairman.

In the filing, King said he is considering asking Americas for representation on its board, soliciting proxies to elect his nominees to the board and soliciting proxies in opposition to the proposed merger.

Kevin King expressed his opposition to the merger in a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, claiming that the Americas chairman is "grossly" overpaid and that certain Advanced Electronics stockholders are also receiving excess payments.
King said he wrote to the SEC requesting it review the merger proposal and he also intends to contact other shareholders regarding the merger.

The Houston-based investor, who holds a five percent stake in the Miami-based company or 63,255 common shares, said the shares at current market prices "present an attractive investment opportunity for capital appreciation."
